OPEN MORNINGS FOR RECEPTION INTAKE 2027
Choosing a school for your child ranks among the most consequential decisions you will make as a parent. It shapes friendships, academic trajectory, self-image, and daily routine for years. At Mitcheldean Endowed Primary School, every child is unique. We are committed to helping every pupil achieve their very best academically while nuturing their wellbeing, confidence and happeniess.
We are a single form village primary school in the heart of Mitcheldean and we pride ourselves on our strong sense of community and family atmosphere.
Please take a look at our open mornings below:
Friday 6th November 9.30am - 10.30am
Wednesday 25th November 10.45 - 11.45am
